from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class InvestingCashFlowInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted investing cash flow information from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the registrant/company the document pertains to")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period covered (e.g., 'For the quarter ended March 31, 2024')")
    line_item_label: str = Field(description="Exact label used for the investing activities line item or section status")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount reported for investing activities; None if not presented separately")
    unit: str = Field(description="Currency scale used for the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    is_present: bool = Field(description="True if a separate investing activities section was reported, False if absent/merged")
    absence_notes: str | None = Field(description="Explanation if the section is not reported (e.g., 'reconciled within operating activities')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flows: list[InvestingCashFlowInfo]
